name: Yamaha MX175 / MX250 / MX360
engine: 171 to 397 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection
intro: Yamaha's street-legal motocross bikes of the mid 70s. Autolube, a twin-shock rear and lights.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
